pipeline._note: v2 became the default after both historical replays passed acceptance with no degraded stage. Selection order is --pipeline, then DIGEST_PIPELINE, then this value, then editorial-pipeline-v1. Set active back to editorial-pipeline-v1 for a rollback, or pass --pipeline v1 per run.

components._note: External component locations for this installation. Each can be overridden by an environment variable, which wins over this file: WOPS_ROOT, WOPS_PYTHON, DIGEST_EVAL_PYTHON. WOPS_ROOT may also be set in .env, which Node loads with --env-file. When wops_root is set and wops_python is not, the WOPS project's own .venv interpreter is used if it exists. A machine-specific path such as an absolute Python interpreter belongs in an ignored copy of this file (system/runtime.json), never in this committed example.

style_profiles._note: Optional per-style default for the editorial style profile a v2 run executes. Keys are canonical style names; values are profile ids from the style-profile registry. An entry here is the configured default for that style, overridden by DIGEST_STYLE_PROFILE and then by --style-profile on the command line. This block is intentionally empty: every style currently defaults to its <style>-legacy profile.

adapters._note: Both adapters degrade rather than fail. A missing WOPS root, an unusable interpreter, an unconfigured credential, or a judge error is recorded as a degraded stage and the pipeline continues with the last valid artifact.
